verdict.rationale: FTB runs an online account portal (MyFTB) where in-product AI insights could plausibly be offered, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains only two probes showing HTTP 403 edge denials on www.ftb.ca.gov and webapp.ftb.ca.gov. Neither says anything about AI-generated insights or suggestions from user data, so there is no evidence the product delivers this.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
